October, 2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:50553
 1 M
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Jabalpur

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pramod Kumar Agrawal
 On The 7 th Of October, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 38259 of 2025
 Rajkumar Dhurve
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Ravindra Singh Ahriwar - Advocate for the applica
 Ms. Ranjana Agnihotri - Dy. Government Advocate for St
 Order

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No. 140/2024 registered at Police Station - Sirali, District - Harda (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Sections 5 and 6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant has been arrested on 04.09.2024.
Previous bail application was dismissed as withdrawn.

2. As per the prosecution story the allegation against the applicant is that he committed rape upon the minor prosecutrix therefore, the aforesaid offence has been registered against the applicant.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
He is in custody since 04.09.2024.
It is further submitted that prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 183 of the BNSS has stated that she herself went with him.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:50553 2 MCRC-38259-2025 Applicant has no criminal antecedents.
Charge-sheet has been filed.
Conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant and prayed for its rejection.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

sentences.text: It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.
7. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
8. Certified copy as per rules.
